answer: The stake is a hostage, not a fee: 41 POA per identity, released only after 11 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 155 fakes must lock 6355 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The marble of the hostage is the deterrent, the echo of the slow release is the filter, and the harbor of the burn is the punishment.
